title: Least privilege: split docs build from Pages deploy
summary: Removes the `deploy` job from `docs.yml` (which keeps lint, build and the Pages artifact upload, callable with `contents: read`), adds `docs-deploy.yml` (push to `main` + `workflow_dispatch`) that calls `docs.yml` for the build and deploys in environment `github-pages` with job-level `pages: write`, `id-token: write`, and reduces the `docs` call in `release.yml` to `contents: read`.
why: A12/§6.1: the release qualification graph grants Pages and OIDC write it never uses. Risks: the deploy loses the artifact if the build job name changes; a `workflow_run` trigger would violate W7 — use a reusable call instead; the `Deploy Documentation` workflow name is referenced by CI evidence lists — keep `docs.yml` named `Documentation` and name the new one `Deploy Documentation`.

include: `docs.yml`: drop job `deploy` and its comment; keep `on.workflow_call`; `name: Documentation`

New `docs-deploy.yml`: jobs `build` (`uses: ./.github/workflows/docs.yml`, `permissions: contents: read`) and `deploy` (`needs: build`, `environment: {name: github-pages, url: ...}`, job permissions `pages: write`, `id-token: write`, `actions/deploy-pages@<sha>`); top-level `permissions: contents: read`, `defaults.run.shell: bash`; `concurrency` group `pages`
`release.yml`: job `docs` permissions `contents: read` only; delete the explanatory comment about deploy permissions
`tests/Arch/ReleaseWorkflowTest.php`: assert the docs call grants only `contents: read`

reads.why: Branch, commits, owner WIP, frozen-contract stop rule, owner gates, evidence

rules: Pin every action in the new file (P1.2 rules).
guidance: GitHub requires the caller to grant at least the permissions of the called jobs; after removing `deploy` from `docs.yml`, `contents: read` suffices. The CI evidence list name changes from `Deploy Documentation` to `Documentation`; update knowledge/execution#ci-evidence usage in this item's evidence only.

validation.cmd: python3 -c 'import yaml,sys; r=yaml.safe_load(open(".github/workflows/release.yml")); d=yaml.safe_load(open(".github/workflows/docs.yml")); ok=r["jobs"]["docs"]["permissions"]=={"contents":"read"} and all("pages" not in (j.get("permissions") or {}) for j in d["jobs"].values()); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)'

validation.procedure: After the owner merges to main (P2.6), `gh run list --workflow docs-deploy.yml --branch main --limit 1 --json conclusion --jq '.[0].conclusion'`

deliverables: Release graph with read-only docs call

result.notes: docs.yml без deploy (name Documentation, только workflow_call+PR), docs-deploy.yml (build через docs.yml, deploy pages/id-token job-level), release docs call contents: read, ReleaseWorkflowTest обновлён; V5 live ждёт merge
